question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cab518af2601d6dbee4452f716df8663e048017dbb8708891500a290f27f538.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

When mirror is placed vertically, the objects get laterally inverted. In other words, the** Left Hand Side** and **Right Hand Side **of an object interchange their places while top and bottom remain the same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0519003129409dd8ac201099d4d929428875cbc8ceb821eb6cc366d9b081fadd.png]
